name: Musicians in a pub in Ireland
text: Musicians in a pub in Ireland appear in a photograph that Koch uses to show the live face of Irish traditional music. The players gather in a common social space, the pub, and perform together. The picture records where the tradition still happens today. This music stays oral, conservative, and amateur in focus. The gathering is always participatory. Those present join in readily, and the tunes remain a shared communal event.
